title: Echo Launches Industry’s First Smart Hydrogen Bottle and App at CES 2025
summary: Echo Water today unveiled its latest breakthrough in hydrogen enriched water technology at CES 2025 in Las Vegas. The Echo Flask and its companion app is the industry’s first smart hydrogen bottle, delivering the highest hydrogen concentration in combination with the largest water capacity on the market.
body:
Science and technology combine to advance the benefits of molecular hydrogen

LAS VEGAS, January 07, 2025--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Echo Water today unveiled its latest breakthrough in hydrogen enriched water technology at CES 2025 in Las Vegas. The Echo Flask and its companion app is the industry’s first smart hydrogen bottle, delivering the highest hydrogen concentration in combination with the largest water capacity on the market.

This innovative duo combines the latest research with intuitive design, allowing users to generate their own healthy hydrogen water directly in the bottle. Hydrogen water is a breakthrough therapy offering a powerful solution to reduce oxidative stress, improve cellular health, and to take endurance and recovery to a new level. In addition to its unprecedented hydrogen delivery capacity, the Echo Flask’s companion app unlocks personalized tracking and protocols along with other smart features for a customized and seamless hydration experience.

"Nobody in the hydrogen water industry has built anything close to the Echo Flask. As the first smart bottle in the industry, it was a tremendous engineering challenge," said Josh Carr, CEO of Echo Water. "However, our amazing team has been able to nearly double the hydrogen dose of our competitors while simultaneously increasing the water capacity by 50%. Despite being told again and again that it could not be done, our team made the impossible possible. If you are looking to optimize your health, the Echo Flask will be life changing for you."

Next-Level Hydration Experience

The Echo Flask features an industry-leading 12-ounce capacity, reducing refill interruptions while delivering consistent hydrogen water. With its advanced proton-exchange membrane technology, the flask achieves a hydrogen concentration up to 8.25 ppm—higher than any hydrogen bottle in the industry (no competitor can match the capacity or concentration)—ensuring faster and more impactful health benefits.

"Hydrogen has demonstrated powerful health benefits for a huge variety of conditions. With the Echo Flask, we’ve created a solution that delivers pure hydrogen gas without harmful byproducts," explained Paul Barattiero, founder of Echo Water. "Built on over 2000 studies and thousands of customer testimonials, every element of this product is designed to improve cellular health, reduce oxidative stress, and promote overall wellness."

Smart Technology for Modern Lifestyles

The Echo Flask combines sophisticated science with user-friendly features, including a touch-screen interface that allows users to customize cycle length, track daily stats, and set reminders. Its purge functionality ensures safe pressure release, while the impact-resistant, BPA-free construction prioritizes durability and safety.

Paired with the Echo Flask App, users can take their hydration and health to the next level. The app is available on iOS and Android and provides in-depth education on the benefits of hydrogen water, personalized goals, and integration with other health tracking apps such as Apple health kit. With features like automatic tracking and social sharing, the app encourages consistency, motivation, and collaboration.

Better Science, Better Health

Echo Water’s innovations stem from a mission to make advanced health solutions based on science more accessible and effective. "The Echo Flask and App are designed for people who want more than hydration—they want performance, recovery, and a healthier lifestyle," added Carr. "This is hydration reimagined."

The Echo Flask features two patents filed which showcase its transformative design and technology that set it apart from competitors.

Availability

The Echo Flask and Echo Flask App will be available for pre-order starting January 8, 2025, with shipping beginning February 5, 2025. CES attendees can experience the product firsthand at Echo Water’s booth No. 54363 in the Health & Wellness Pavilion.

For more information, visit www.echowater.com.

About Echo Water

Echo is a leader in hydrogen water technology, dedicated to transforming health and wellness through cutting-edge science and innovation. With a mission to make advanced hydration solutions accessible to everyone, Echo Water designs products that combine purity, performance, and personalized technology. From the groundbreaking Echo Flask to the user-friendly Echo Flask App, the company empowers individuals to optimize their health by integrating science-backed benefits into their daily lives. For more information, visit www.echowater.com.
